title: approvals: a principal holding N of a step's approver slots — the chip's ×N and the eligible-approver count need the copy that reconciles them
body:
domain:ui#4 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbDAucNyQ4UtzCJKyh

Filing gate: ① user-visible UX defect, an out-of-scope finding of the in-flight #27502 (card thread report 6499712026), filed by the seat as ruling 6499914328 item 7 directs (`domain:ui` · `area:workflow` · S). Not part of #27502's PR.

## Business reason

Who: every approver (and submitter) reading a pending approval whose step lets one person hold several approver slots. What happens today: on the approval request page, before the decision, the pending step reads `Waiting on Dev Admin ×3` beside "1 eligible approver", with nothing explaining the ×3 (found in the 18.3.0 RC walkthrough, #27377 W3-UX, on #27502). Both numbers are correct readings of the request row, but side by side they look contradictory, and a reader cannot tell whether one person or three must still act.

## Where (read at `origin/main`)

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordApprovalsPanel.tsx` `approverChips` (~L147): collapses the slots one principal holds into one chip with a `×N` count. The same function draws the business record's approvals panel.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/approval-progress/eligibleApprovers.ts` `eligibleApproverCount` (~L33, objectui#12781): counts distinct principals; `RecordApprovalsPanel.tsx` ~L398 reads it.
- Why the stock walkthrough always shows it: `examples/app-showcase/src/security/seed-approval-demo.ts` (header, ~L10–37) routes the committee node to the positions `manager` / `finance` / `legal` and assigns the dev-seeded admin to all three.

## Acceptance

- When one principal holds several of a step's slots, the chip and the eligible count read as one story (e.g. the chip names what the ×N counts, or the count line says the person holds N slots); the wording is this card's to decide.
- No new widget, dialog or hook: copy on the existing chip / count line, in the ui language packs, pinned by a test on a principal holding several slots.

## Reader who acts

The `domain:ui` seat whose area holds approval pages (seat 4, #26620) or the one triage names.

## reach

Public door: the console approval request page for the showcase `EXP-DEMO` request ("High-Value Expense — Committee Quorum") signed in as the seeded admin (repro steps on #27502).
